oneLiner: Guard merchant convoys through a contested strait: tap to intercept drones, missiles and jets before they hit.
problem: Mobile tower-defense and missile-defense games are mostly free-to-play grinds with ads and timers. Players who want a tight, readable, offline arcade-strategy game with real depth have few premium-feeling options.
audience: Strategy and arcade players (teens and adults) who like Missile Command, tower defense and roguelite runs, and play in short landscape sessions on iPhone.
coreLoop: Pick a map and the one upgrade each Armory bay gives this run, then defend the convoy for ten waves: tap threats to intercept them, grab weapon drops from kills and fire them, and draft a new weapon after every wave. A run ends with Armory cards that make the next run stronger and, on a clear, the next map.
differentiator: Twenty hand-built maps where each one adds one new idea (supertankers, lock gates, shore batteries, drifting mines, night, a battleship crossing), twelve weapons that each answer a kind of attack, and a fully offline game with no ads.
mvpFeatures: 20 maps in four chapters, ten waves each, endless mode after a clear
Tap-to-intercept defense of the convoy and the carrier
Twelve drafted weapons dropped as pickups, three held, three levels each
The Armory: eleven upgrade cards in three bays, won after runs
Game Center leaderboards per map and achievements
Native saves, haptics and a landscape full-screen shell
Chapter 1 free; one in-app purchase unlocks chapters 2–4, with Restore Purchases

source.notes: Vite + TypeScript canvas game (V3, v3.html). Store flavour + Capacitor iOS project built in the game repo (workstream W1); app_farm ships it as app.kind web-game.

risks.risk: A web-view (Capacitor) shell can be judged a repackaged website
risks.mitigation: Complete offline game in the binary, nothing remote, native storage, haptics, Game Center and StoreKit; review notes list the native features; preflight web-game checks
StoreKit non-consumable, Restore Purchases in Settings, chapter 1 fully playable free, no external payment
Fictional strait and factions, abstract vector art, no gore; age rating answers cartoon/fantasy violence (infrequent/mild)
